records.description: La Planchada, the Mexican nurse spirit of local legend, in an original gentle cultural illustration. Clearly adult woman with dark neatly braided hair, warm tan complexion, pressed ivory vintage nurse uniform with high buttoned collar and long sleeves, plain nurse cap, holding carefully folded linen and a tiny amber lamp. No logo on cap. Upper-body portrait from waist up. Calm expression, kind greeting, and peaceful smile in three poses.

records.description: La Pascualita, the enchanted bridal-shop mannequin from the Chihuahua local legend, as an original miniature adult display mannequin. Adult woman's elegant porcelain doll face with dark wavy hair, subtle wooden joint seams at wrists, fully covering vintage ivory lace wedding gown with high neckline and long sleeves, lace veil and a small flower bouquet. Original sculptural figure, not a likeness of the real shop mannequin. Upper body from waist up. Three gentle expressions and slight bouquet positions.
